thread:
Asha (People Ops): Quick FYI — we're launching a short Privacy + Sensitive Data micro-sprint next week. Mandatory for all full-time ICs + managers. Expected time: ~30 min (video + 10-min quiz).
Liam (HR): Thanks — what's the deadline for completion?
Asha (People Ops): Completion window: 7 days from enrollment email. We need manager confirmations (in the sheet) by the end of that window.
Devon (Eng Manager): Can managers enroll people on behalf of contractors? Some on my team are contractors.
Marta (Legal): Contractors are required if they access customer PII. If not, mark as "NA" in column C on the tracker and assign the shorter privacy refresher instead.
Allie (People Ops): Enrollment flow: we'll auto-email people Monday 9am PT. Link + one-click ack. Managers get a separate link to confirm completion rows. Sheet: https://rwd.in/sprint-tracker (view/edit restricted to managers & people-ops)
Devon (Eng Manager): Got it. Can managers batch-confirm or do we need per-person clicks?
Asha (People Ops): Batch confirm allowed — there is a "Mark team complete" button on the tracker. We still need per-person quiz completion for records.
Devon (Eng Manager): OK. Will ping my leads to make sure they reserve time.
Liam (HR): What about accommodations (e.g., extended time, language)?
Asha (People Ops): Good call. Use the "accommodations" column on the tracker and tag @Allie. We'll handle extended timelines and translations case-by-case.
Allie (People Ops): If someone needs a translator/alt language, flag it by EOD Tuesday. We'll queue a recorded session in Spanish and Portuguese if demand > 5.
Marta (Legal): Also note: the updated policy appendix requires an e-signature for the Data Handling Addendum. We'll push the esign to users after quiz completion.
esign-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: 1 pending e-sign (Data Handling Addendum) for user devon.j@redwood.ai — link expires in 7 days.
Devon (Eng Manager): Will remind my team. Any way to see who hasn't started?
Asha (People Ops): Tracker view has "Not started" / "In progress" / "Complete". We'll also send managers a mid-window reminder (Day 3).
Liam (HR): Can we get a CSV export for compliance?
Allie (People Ops): Yes — export available under the tracker menu. We'll store final CSV in the compliance S3 bucket and attach to the employee's training record.
Devon (Eng Manager): One more — will completion impact performance cycle deadlines? We have reviews next month and don't want training noise.
Asha (People Ops): No impact on performance ratings. We just need completion for compliance audit.
Marta (Legal): Audit note: keep completion timestamps and quiz scores for 3 years.
Devon (Eng Manager): Thanks, team. I'll confirm once my org is enrolled.
Asha (People Ops): Thanks. Quick checklist for managers: 1) confirm roster on tracker, 2) flag contractors as NA if appropriate, 3) approve accommodations, 4) use batch-confirm after quiz verification. Ping me or @Allie with questions. :thumbsup:
Allie (People Ops): I'll post the enrollment FAQ in #people-ops-resources later today and drop the sample manager email.
Asha (People Ops): End-of-thread note: enrollment email scheduled Mon 9am PT. Please confirm your manager roster in the tracker by 12pm Mon if you want any changes before launch.
